title: Surreal Automotive Carousel
description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a large metallic swirling structure at center with various vehicles displayed on floating circular platforms along a winding road. Visible brands include Cadillac, Ford, McDonald's, Hooters, and Chevrolet, set against a psychedelic night sky with glowing golden arches and floating McDonald's fries.
prompt: Surreal night scene with a massive shiny metallic swirling sculpture at the center. A winding road loops around it carrying a black Cadillac Escalade, blue Ford Mustang, black pickup truck, orange Hooters delivery truck, and silver Chevrolet SUV on floating platforms. In the background are glowing yellow McDonald's arches, a giant McDonald's cup, a pink Cadillac building covered in black silhouettes, floating fries and logos, all rendered in a vibrant psychedelic style with rich purples, pinks and glowing accents.
